paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotions, with six distinct categories represented. The chart contains slices labeled as Frustration, Neutral, Happiness, Excitement, Anger, and Sadness. Frustration is marked in light blue with 25.1%, Neutral in a darker blue at 23.1%, Happiness is depicted in blue with 8.1%, Anger in yellow at 14.9%, Sadness shown in orange at 14.7% and Excitement shown in red at 14.1%. Each slice has its percentage label displayed inside, aiding in the quantification of each category. The slices are ordered by size starting from Frustration as the largest to Happiness as the smallest. There is no legend accompanying the chart, and none of the slices are visually emphasized such as being offset or bolded.
